figures.caption: Fig. 2. The framework of our proposed method, consisting of a forward concealing module and two backward revealing modules. The former embeds secret information into cover images, generating stego images on-the-fly for subsequent steganalysis. The two revealing modules function as image steganalyzers to distinguish between stego images and cover images via measuring the similarity between inputs and corresponding recovered content.

Fig. 1. The motivation of our proposed method. We consider a scenario, namely zero-shot interpretable image steganalysis, to simultaneously address the drawbacks, i.e., generalizability and interpretability, of existing works.
